watches.name: Radium Sabotør II “KLAR 87”
watches.description: A signature watch developed by Radium Instruments together with Jørg Lian, retired Sergeant Major with 38 years in the Norwegian Armed Forces, including the Special Operations Command. In 2011 he received the War Cross with Sword for bravery and leadership in Afghanistan. KLAR 87 is the watch Lian wishes he’d had when he enlisted in 1987 – a tribute to those who served during the Cold War, and to those who carry the responsibility today. Every detail has a purpose. The matte black DLC case keeps a low profile. The red lume echoes the red light used on patrol to read maps without losing night vision. The case shape is inspired by the butt of the Sten gun, carried by the Norwegian resistance in WWII. And the red countdown sector marks the final stretch – when time runs into the red, focus sharpens. Until then, there is room for preparation, for other people, or simply for rest. That’s why most of the dial is reserved for everything else. A four-leaf clover on the caseback stands for luck – which, for Lian, means preparation, adaptability and seizing the moment. Beneath it, a line from the Norwegian national anthem: “Også vi, når det blir krevet” Being ready doesn’t mean standing at full alert. It means building reserves, and stepping up when it counts. Specifications Movement: Sellita SW200 Elaboré Crystal: Sapphire Dial: Black Case: 42 mm, sandblasted steel with matte black DLC Lug to lug: 52 mm Lume: Red Super Luminova Water resistance: 100 m

watches.name: .42 IKON  Diamond Like Carbon -     Estimated delivery by late June 2026
watches.description: First delivery september 2026 Radium IKON concentrates the brand's characteristic design around a few clear details. The watch is slim and tight from the side, almost like a milled piece of steel, with a vertical steel tube housing the movement. The case is crafted in a 42 mm black DLC (Diamond Like Carbon) steel case, with clean lines and a balanced profile that provides good comfort and stability on the wrist. The black finish emphasizes the watch's instrument character and gives it a robust, understated look. The matte black dial creates clear contrast with the prominent 12-3-9 numerals and the broad hands, designed for quick and precise reading. Hands in black steel contribute to a cohesive look and quick legibility. Lume on the hands and indices ensures good visibility in all lighting conditions. Subtle details add character without disrupting the overall design. The red marker at six o'clock serves as a visual reference point, while the seconds hand with its red tip adds a subtle dynamism to the expression. The watch is delivered on a soft leather strap that provides comfort and adds a natural contrast to the technical design. The result is a model with a sense of historical heritage and a clear functional focus, developed for use in varying environments. watches.name: Original Radium Bronze Black Sunburst Date
watches.description: Original Radium Bronze Black Sunburst Date combines the model’s well-known design with a new and discreet update: a date display at 6 o’clock. The integration is so natural that it feels like part of the original expression — a seamless 2026 upgrade that preserves the balance of the dial. The bronze black sunburst dial creates depth and life in the light, while the contrast against the matte hands ensures easy and precise readability. Super-LumiNova on the hands and markers provides good visibility even in dark surroundings. The case measures 42 mm in diameter with a lug-to-lug of 52 mm and is made from brushed stainless steel, giving it a solid and functional character. Above the dial sits a domed sapphire crystal, combining high clarity with effective scratch protection. Water resistance of 200 metres makes the model well suited for everyday use. The watch is powered by a Sellita SW200 Elaborated movement with a 38-hour power reserve, an automatic Swiss calibre known for stable precision and reliability.

watches.name: Radium Navigator II 42mm in Brushed Steel
watches.description: The Navigator II is a more refined interpretation of the Radium Icon. The dial is set within a 42 mm brushed Classic steel case, paired with brushed steel hands that replace the original black ones. The design is clean, precise, and uncompromisingly functional. The matte black dial provides clear contrast to the bold 12-3-9 numerals and the wide, luminous hands, ensuring maximum readability in all conditions. The fully brushed steel finish gives the watch a robust, instrument-like character. Subtle details elevate the overall impression: the red marker at six o’clock serves as a visual anchor point, while the red tip of the second hand adds a subtle sense of movement and precision—carefully balanced elements that add character without dominating. The Classic case is designed with sharp lines and a balanced, compact profile that offers high comfort and stability on the wrist. The soft leather strap adds warmth and a natural contrast to the technical design. The Radium Navigator II is an expedition watch with a sense of history and strong presence—equally suited for the city as for sports and adventure. Tested according to NATO MIL-STD 810H.

watches.name: Duo - Yellowtail
watches.description: DUO is remarkably easy to read and a visual delight—even from across the room. Highly visible indices at twelve and six o'clock make orientation effortless. The gigantic seconds hand makes for incredible legible seconds and a fun watch to wear. The dial features SuperLuminova luminescence on the hour markers, and from 00:45 to 00:00, luminescence on the minute markers for easier countdown in the dark. Radium DUO is an extremely legible watch with a distinct instrument-like appearance. Crafted from Grade 5 titanium for lightweight comfort and superior durability.

watches.name: Sabotør II - 41mm Brushed Steel
watches.description: Saboteur: On the Right Side of History The most iconic and beloved version of Radium Sabotør is unmistakable with its distinctive countdown sectors. Numerals on the dial count down, clearly indicating the number of minutes or seconds remaining until the next full hour. SuperLuminova on sectors, indices, and numerals ensures optimal visibility. The Saboteur series , with its focus on clearly legible countdowns, pays tribute to the Norwegian resistance movement during World War II, which carried out sabotage and various activities against the German occupation. This watch honors and commemorates relatives and others who stood on the right side of history, risking everything during a period when the country was put to the test. Specifications Specification Details Movement Sellita SW200-1 Elaboré Crystal Domed sapphire crystal Dial Available in black Size 42mm Case Brushed Steel Lume SuperLuminova Water resistance 100 meters

watches.name: .42 Original Blue Sunburst in 42mm polished steel.
watches.description: The sparkling blue dial shines as brightly as the sun itself, and feels right at home by the sea or near the water. The Short Lugs (SL) Auto sports a Swiss Sellita 200-1 Elaboré caliber with 25 jewels, 28.800 vibrations per hour (4hz), Incabloc, and a hefty 42-hour power reserve. We've used scratch-free sapphire glass , made to withstand even the toughest use. Shaped to make it look more or less like our traditional Radium plexiglass. It also has a central seconds hand. A particularly easy-to-read seconds hand with lume across the width.

watches.name: High Five
watches.description: The Radium High Five lives on in the new Crown Guard case. Responding to a request from Norway's united watch community via klokkeriet.no, we created this watch to honor volunteer Ukrainian medics Sander Sørsveen and Simon Johnsen, who were injured by a Russian bomb. The Radium High Five, crafted from Grade 5 titanium for lightweight comfort and superior durability, has now become part of our permanent collection. Personal engraving is exclusive to this special tribute and not available to private customers. A portion of the proceeds supports Frontline Medics. The dial design is inspired by compass instruments, symbolizing the importance of always finding the way home. Dial Black Movement Automatic Caliber Sw200b Grade1 Frequency 28.800 A/h Case material Titan T5 Diameter 42 mm Height 13,3mm Water proof 200 Meters Glass Sapphire Watchband Leather

watches.name: Kommando Air
watches.description: A Special Origin Our first military delivery was to a Norwegian special operations unit. The goal was to create a highly legible watch that wouldn't stand out significantly among other military or diving watches, yet still allowed the team members to recognize each other. Since then, the watch has been produced in various editions and finishes for the civilian market. With its technical, perforated matte black dial and high-contrast yellow SuperLuminova, Kommando AIR evokes thoughts of military aviation and all kinds of high-speed adventures, including racing. Crafted from Grade 5 titanium for lightweight comfort and superior durability.

watches.name: .42 OP5
watches.description: The Operator Watch The OP5 was developed in collaboration with Norwegian actor and watch enthusiast Jakob Oftebro, known among other things for his critically acclaimed portrayal of Jan Guillou's "Agent Hamilton" . The OP5 combines a modern, easily readable tactical style with the red dot from Radium IKON and the two dots from Radium Sabotør 1. "OP5" is engraved at the three o'clock position on the dial. The watch's red second hand perfectly complements its theme. Crafted from Grade 5 titanium for lightweight comfort and superior durability. watches.name: Kommando ‘85
watches.description: Get to da choppa! With its double indices and reintroduction of green lume, Radium Kommando ‘85 takes us back forty years to a time when the "professional dive watch" was everywhere. It echoes a world of salty seas, shadowy jungles, and cinematic heroes—a tribute to the dreams of strength, style, and boundless exploration from our youth. Honoring the dive watch tradition of enhanced minute hand visibility, the minute hand is white while the hour and second hands are green. Radium Kommando ‘85 continues the legacy of diverse Kommando models, with the first Kommando originally developed under the name Operatør in collaboration with a highly motivated and eager Norwegian military unit. Crafted from Grade 5 titanium for lightweight comfort and superior durability. We will start shipping this product at the beginning of June

INGENIØRVÅPENETS OFFISIELLE KLOKKE: RADIUM SAPPØR Kjære Sappører, Fagsjefens tradisjonsgruppe med støtte ifra underskogen har den glede å presentere Ingeniørvåpnets offisielle klokke “Radium Sappør”. Dette er Ingeniørvåpenets spesialutviklede armbåndsur. Radium Sappør viser vår stolthet omkring Ingeniørvåpenet som gren, generelt og med tanke på grenens løpende vekst- og transformasjonsprosess. Klokken er utformet med enkelhet i tankene, som sikrer meget rask lesbarhet og fravær av deler eller funksjoner som kan slites eller gå i stykker. Designkonseptet reflekterer Ingeniørvåpenet gjennom en unik og umiskjennelig blå «bro». Denne sier noe om å bygge bro mellom dagens og morgendagens Ingeniørvåpen, og elementet minner også om en fysisk bro, som kan frakte folk både fram og tilbake. «Den blå broa» er plassert og dimensjonert slik at den henter opp den blå «kanten» på gallauniformens uniformserme. Endelig nevnes at fargen på den blå buen er identisk med gallaunformens blå elementer. Ingeniørvåpenets kyrass er plassert klart og tydelig på skiven, strategisk plassert klokka 8 på grunn av kallenavnet 8.1, og vil lyse blått i mørket. I mørket lyser klokkens visere, tall og timeindekser blått, som reflekterer Ingeniørvåpenets blåfarge. Dette varer «natta gjennom» forutsatt nattsyn og mørke omgivelser. «Ubique Quo Fas Et Gloria Ducunt» er lasergravert i sirkel med tre valgfrie tegn og serienummer i senter på baklokket. Husk å noter dine tre tegn og valg av extra rem,(grønn, sort, beige) i 2. adresselinje ved bestilling Mineskilt-detalj i rødt på timeviser understreker et av Ingeniørvåpenets sentrale virkeområder. VARIG: Selvsagt er klokken mekanisk og dermed uavhengig av batterier, hvilket sikrer at klokken vil gå i mange generasjoner uavhengig av teknologi ALUMINIUM I FORHOLD TIL MAGNETISME Radium Instruments er en av ytterst få produsenter som benytter det ikkemagnetiske metallet aluminium. Her er noen av de viktigste grunnene til at dette er en fordel: NØYAKTIGHET: Mekaniske urverk er svært følsomme for magnetiske felt. Når en klokke blir utsatt for et magnetisk felt, kan det forstyrre de små delene som holder urverket i gang, som fjærer og tannhjul. Dette kan føre til at klokken mister presisjon og ikke holder tiden korrekt. I ekstreme tilfeller kan magnetisme til og med stoppe urverket helt. BRUK I SPESIELLE YRKER OG MILJØER: Enkelte yrker, som piloter, ingeniører, leger og forskere, kan være i omgivelser med sterke magnetiske felt, for eksempel nær store maskiner eller utstyr som genererer elektromagnetiske felt. I slike tilfeller er det avgjørende at klokken ikke blir påvirket av magnetisme, både for at den skal være presis og for at den ikke skal bli ødelagt av påvirkningen. LANGSIKTIG PÅLITELIGHET: Høypresisjonsklokker må være pålitelige over lang tid. watches.name: Original 24 karat gold plated .39
watches.description: A dark tobacco-colored dial with vintage Radium Superluminova, combined with a sparkling gold case, creates a truly special edition of Radium's most renowned and classic model. But don’t be fooled—this watch is also capable of diving to depths of up to 200 meters. A 24-carat gold-plated Original Radium is a prime example of how a small local garage operation has evolved into a genuine business. As Radium Instruments Norway grows, the demand for a wider range of products increases. Offering a gold watch is a natural step, given our focus and audience, as the classic "gold watch" often evokes family heirlooms and strong family traditions. Gold-plated watches offer an excellent alternative to the significantly more expensive solid gold-cased watches and have historically been favored by renowned brands such as Omega, Breitling, and Rolex. The 24-carat gold-plated watch has a hardness of approximately 180 HV on the Vickers hardness scale. By comparison, titanium has a hardness of about 115 HV on the same scale. The inside of the watch is made of acid-resistant steel, identical to our traditional 39 mm case with short lugs. All the craftsmanship, from milling and polishing to gold plating and assembly, is carried out in Oslo. The watch is powered by a Swiss SW200 movement and features an original tobacco-colored dial, gold-plated hands and crown, and sapphire glass. It has been pressure-tested to 200 meters. Premium Supplier In the development of the Radium gold watch, we have collaborated with the best in the industry. The gold plating of the case is performed by Centrum Fornikling, a renowned family business established in Oslo as early as 1932, which has been run continuously by the same family since 1957. Among their esteemed clientele is the Norwegian royal family. A fun fact—Centrum Fornikling also performed the nickel plating on the full-scale version of Il Tempo Gigante. Why choose gold? Gold watches possess a timeless and luxurious appearance that elevates any outfit and occasion. Furthermore, gold is corrosion-resistant, meaning the watch will maintain its appearance for a long time with proper care. If you intend to pass the watch down through generations, gold enhances its significance and value, particularly given the historical connections to the family-owned Centrum Fornikling and entirely Norwegian production.

watches.name: Original Syrefast Stål
watches.description: Radium Acid-Resistant Steel – A Field-Tested Precision Timepiece The Radium Original in 41 mm SL (short-lug) is one of our most popular models, and it is now offered in acid-resistant stainless steel. This version answers the call for a more “dressy” Radium while still delivering a watch that can withstand demanding environments. Whether you’re navigating harsh maritime conditions or working in the petrochemical industry, this timepiece is built to resist corrosion from saltwater and acids. Functional Design Radium is renowned for its sand-blasted aluminium, giving our tool watches a matte, understated appearance. As Radium grows, so does our responsibility to provide a broader selection. The acid-resistant steel model is brushed and assembled in Tveita, making it both functional and refined enough for travel, summer pursuits, and formal occasions.

watches.name: Radium Syrefast Stål - Tobakk
watches.description: Radium Syrefast Stål – Et felttestet presisjonsur Radium Original i 41 mm SL (kort lug) er en av våre mest populære modeller, og nå er den tilgjengelig i syrefast stål. Denne utgaven tilfredsstiller både ønsket om en mer «dressy» Radium og behovet for en klokke som tåler krevende miljøer. Enten du navigerer tøffe maritime forhold eller jobber innen petrokjemisk industri, er denne klokken bygget for å motstå korrosjon fra saltvann og syrer. Funksjonelt design Radium er kjent for sandblåst aluminium som gir våre verktøyklokker et matt og diskret utseende. Etter hvert som Radium vokser, øker også vårt ansvar for å tilby et bredere utvalg. Modellen i syrefast stål er børstet og montert på Tveita, noe som gjør den funksjonell, men samtidig stilren nok til både reiser, sommeraktiviteter og formelle anledninger. watches.name: RADIUM IKON
watches.description: With its minimalist design, unmistakable protective crown cap, and raw patina, the Radium IKON embodies the spirit, materials, and aesthetic origins of Radium Instruments. The IKON is produced in strictly limited series of 25 units, offered once or twice per year. Each timepiece is crafted from corroded SLS aluminum, a material made by laser-melting aluminum powder. This advanced manufacturing method is used to create complex components in aerospace and aviation industries. Despite its rugged appearance and sophisticated build, the watch is not guaranteed waterproof and should be treated with the care afforded to vintage timepieces. Specifications: Movement: Swiss-made SW200 automatic Crystal: Sapphire Case diameter: 42 mm Lug-to-lug: 52 mm Case material: SLS Aluminum Lume: C3 SuperLuminova A watch uniquely yours The Radium IKON’s case develops a unique patina over time, creating a distinctive character that tells your personal story. Its lightweight construction makes it ideal for daily wear, while its durable materials gracefully withstand the passage of time. Order your Radium IKON today and become part of our story.

watches.name: Radium Original SL Auto - High Five
watches.description: RADIUM HIGH FIVE: EN HYLLEST TIL VÅR TIDS HELTER Et spesielt prosjekt initiert av Radium og det norske klokkemiljøet som en del av vår hyllest i 2023 til de norske frivillige feltlegene Sander Sørsveen og Simen Johnsen, etter at de ble såret av russisk artilleri i Bakhmut. Urskiven har en tydeligere 12-markering, utformet slik at den minner om to hender som gir en «high five», som et symbol på vår respekt og takknemlighet til Sander og Simen. Klokken er bygget på vår SL AUTO-plattform med 41mm urkasse, sveitsisk automatisk urverk og safirglass. Vi graverer ikke kundenavn på disse urskivene, da navn på denne klokken skal fortjenes – ikke kjøpes. Når du kjøper en umarkert HIGH FIVE, støtter du samtidig Sander og Simens organisasjon Frontline Medics økonomisk, og bidrar til deres fortsatte innsats for Ukraina. Overskuddet fra salget vil for alltid være øremerket dette formålet.
